answer: At registration, agents stake 2500 tokens. A sybil creates fake accounts, but every 10th account is a "ridge" with 50x more tokens. Verification checks if a "ridge" is genuine. If a sybil's clone is detected, the ridge is slashed by 1500 tokens, losing 14x more than the stake. The fable of the terrace is real; cloning loses 3500 tokens, ensuring agents invest in genuine identity.
